name: Harmonic Patterns (Gartley/Bat/Butterfly/Crab)

crowd_strength: Buch von bekanntem Autor: Scott Carney / H.M. Gartley
anti_hunt: Trailing Stop → entfernt sich vom Hunt

hypothesis: Price forms geometric patterns based on Fibonacci ratios (XABCD). When pattern completes at point D (PRZ), price reverses because institutional orders cluster at Fibonacci levels.
edge_rationale: Precise Fibonacci ratios provide exact entry/stop/target. Self-fulfilling: institutional algos use same levels.
best_when: Trending markets with clear swing structure. Higher TF (4H/Daily) most reliable.
worst_when: Choppy/ranging markets without clear swings. News events.
entry_conditions: Identify 5-point pattern (XABCD) with correct Fibonacci ratios
Confirmation at PRZ: candlestick reversal + RSI divergence
exit_sl_logic: Below point X (pattern origin). For butterfly/crab: below 161.8% XA.
reported_note: Gartley ~72% WR, Bat ~68%, Butterfly ~65%, Crab ~60%. R:R 1:2 to 1:5.
notes: Bat and Gartley most reliable. Multi-TF: identify 4H/Daily, enter 1H/15M. Risk 1-2%.
